tagline: Global leader in low-carbon energy and environmental services
hero_kpi_rationale: Gradual improvement in operational performance with a positive trend reflecting efficiency gains in the energy transition

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin shows how much money remains after paying the direct costs of production.
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key profitability indicator in the energy sector.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin measures operating profit before taxes relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Engie is gradually improving its margin through efficiency gains and optimization of its operating costs.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Engie invests moderately in R&D compared to pure technology players, with a strategic focus on low-carbon technologies and decarbonized energy solutions.
kpis.signal: Modest R&D, concentrated on energy efficiency and low-carbon technologies

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested each year in physical assets such as energy infrastructure and networks.
kpis.description: Engie is increasing investments in renewable energy, smart grids, and decarbonized infrastructure to support its low-carbon strategy.
kpis.signal: Capex rising to accelerate the energy transition and develop renewable assets

kpis.name: Headcount (number of employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company across all operations.
kpis.description: Engie is optimizing its cost structure through a gradual and controlled reduction of its workforce while strengthening its technological capabilities.
kpis.signal: Gradual workforce optimization in the context of digital transformation

ai_positioning.summary: Engie adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, primarily using it for energy grid optimization and predictive maintenance.
evidence: Use of AI for energy demand forecasting
Deployment of predictive analytics models on renewable assets
Limited partnerships with AI startups in the energy sector
